mapper.select: select * from integration_schema.job_definition where job_code=#{jobCode} for update

select d.*,c.baseline_complete,c.committed_cursor,c.last_success_at,c.version as checkpoint_version, r.run_id as latest_run_id,r.status as latest_status from integration_schema.job_definition d join integration_schema.sync_checkpoint c using(job_code) left join lateral (select run_id,status from integration_schema.job_run where job_code=d.job_code order by created_at desc limit 1) r on true order by d.job_code
mapper.update: update integration_schema.job_definition set enabled=#{enabled} where job_code=#{jobCode}
